title: N_'s Bigger Villages!
description: This datapack adds bigger villages to your Minecraft world!
body:
This datapack adds bigger villages to your Minecraft world! If you ever thought those villages with only a few houses were too small, then this is the pack for you! Villages in this pack are bigger by about 2.5x! warning it might make your world load slower

Supported types of villages is: Plains, Snowy, Savanna, Taiga, Desert 




In order to get the datapack in your world (just in case you don't know how to)

When starting a world:
  Step #1: go to the "More" tab

  Step #2: go to the datapacks section which is under experiments

  Step #3: either drag the datapack into the left part of the screen or alternatively click the     
           "Open Pack Folder" button and paste the pack in there

  Step #4: hover your mouse over the icon of the pack and click the arrow

If you already have a world:

  Step #1: open your world folder

  Step #2: go to datapacks folder

  Step #3: paste the datapack in there
